instruction: Resample, interpolate, and align multiple time-series streams recorded at different sampling rates onto a common time grid. Implement upsampling using linear, cubic spline, and PCHIP interpolation, and downsampling using decimation with anti-aliasing (low-pass filtering before subsampling) to prevent aliasing artifacts. Given a set of channels with heterogeneous sampling frequencies and potentially misaligned start times, produce a synchronized DataFrame on a user-specified target frequency. Validate alignment accuracy by measuring the maximum time offset between resampled channels. Discuss the trade-offs in choosing interpolation method, target frequency, and anti-aliasing filter cutoff for different signal types.
description: Resample and align multi-rate time-series data onto a common time grid using interpolation and anti-aliased decimation. Validate temporal alignment accuracy across channels.
keywords: resampling, interpolation, time alignment, upsampling, downsampling, anti-aliasing, decimation, PCHIP, cubic spline, multi-rate, time-series, pandas, scipy, python, synchronization
